cues: The nitro group withdraws electrons and spreads the phenoxide's negative charge further, stabilising it.
Para cresol's methyl group does the opposite, and ethanol has no ring at all to spread the charge.
text: D, para nitrophenol. The nitro group withdraws electrons and spreads the phenoxide's negative charge further, stabilising it. Para cresol's methyl group does the opposite, and ethanol has no ring at all to spread the charge.
